sections.A: Non-specific neck pain woh dard hai jis ki koi khaas serious ya nerve wali wajah nahi milti. Yeh bohat aam hai, aur 'non-specific' ka matlab yeh nahi ke dard asli nahi.
sections.B: Aksar ek taraf ka gardan ka dard jo kandhe ya shoulder blades ke beech phail sakta hai, der tak baithne, phone ya gaari chalane se barhta hai, aur gardan ka ghoomna kam hota hai.
sections.C: Pata karein dard kahan tak jata hai, kaun sa kaam barhata hai, kitni der se hai, aur kya baazu mein jhunjhunahat ya red flag hai.
sections.D: Posture, gardan ki movement, baazu mein symptoms hon to neuro screen, aur joints aur muscles ki jaanch.
sections.E: Koi test non-specific neck pain ko confirm nahi karta. Tests doosri conditions ko rule out karne aur treatment ka target dhoondne ke liye hain.
sections.F: Radiculopathy, myelopathy, shoulder ka masla aur dil ka dard isi jaisa lag sakta hai.
sections.G: Bukhar, cancer ki history, wazan kam hona, dono haathon ka bhaari-pan, ya seene ka dard: in mein pehle refer karein.
sections.H: Red flags, phir neuro signs, phir UMN signs. Kuch na ho aur movement dard wali aur kam ho to diagnosis non-specific neck pain.
sections.I: Thoracic manipulation, gardan ki mobilisation aur Mulligan SNAGs. Behtar nateeja manual therapy aur exercise ko mila kar milta hai.
sections.J: Gardan ki movement, deep neck flexors, rows, shoulder aur upper back ki taaqat, aur thoracic extension.
sections.K: Garmi aur TENS optional. Traction, ultrasound aur laser aam taur par nahi.
sections.L: Pehli visit: tasalli aur exercise shuru. 2 se 6 hafte: taaqat barhayein. Uske baad endurance, kaam ki zaroorat aur khud sambhalna.
sections.M: NDI, dard, rotation aur patient ka goal. 4 se 6 hafte mein farq na ho to diagnosis dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 34 saal ke software developer ko screen kaam ke baad gardan dard hai. Pehle khud plan socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
